PHASE 106 IMPLEMENTATION REPORT: Agent API Integration + Task TTL + Scheduled Retention

## Summary
Integrated the async execution queue with the agent execution API, added task TTL (time-to-live) for automatic cleanup of stale tasks, and implemented scheduled retention cleanup for PostgreSQL. Addresses GPT-4o Phase 105 findings: High (no task TTL), Medium (queue not integrated with agent API).

## Components Built

### 1. Task TTL Manager (TaskTTLManager class)
- Default TTL: 86400 seconds (24 hours)
- Configurable TTL via set_ttl(seconds)
- is_task_expired(): checks if task age exceeds TTL
- get_expired_task_ids(): returns IDs of terminal (completed/failed/cancelled/timeout) tasks that have expired
- cleanup_expired(): removes expired terminal tasks from in-memory store
- start_periodic_cleanup(): background asyncio task that runs cleanup every 3600 seconds (1 hour)
- stop_periodic_cleanup(): cancels background cleanup
- Pending/running tasks are NOT cleaned up (only terminal tasks)

### 2. Scheduled Retention (ScheduledRetention class)
- Default retention: 30 days
- set_cleanup_callback(): sets the async PG cleanup function
- start(interval_seconds): background asyncio task for periodic PG cleanup (default: daily)
- stop(): cancels scheduled cleanup
- Calls the PG cleanup callback (cleanup_old_queue_tasks) on schedule
- Designed to run automatically in production

### 3. Agent Queue Integrator (AgentQueueIntegrator class)
- set_gateway_executor(): sets the AI Gateway call function as the queue executor
- submit_agent_task(): submit a task to the queue (returns task_id)
- execute_agent_task(): submit and wait for completion (returns result dict)
- get_task_status(): get task status by ID
- list_agent_tasks(): list tasks, filterable by agent_id and status
- get_queue_stats(): queue statistics
- get_dlq_stats(): DLQ statistics (uses queue's own DLQ instance)
- get_dlq_entries(): list DLQ entries
- requeue_dlq_task(): re-queue a failed task from DLQ back into the queue
- All DLQ methods use the queue's own DLQ instance (not global)

### 4. Global Instances
- ttl_manager: TaskTTLManager (24h TTL)
- scheduled_retention: ScheduledRetention (30 day retention)
- agent_queue: AgentQueueIntegrator wrapping the global execution_queue

### 5. Tests (test_agent_queue_integration.py, 24 tests)
TestTaskTTL (7 tests): init, set_ttl, is_task_expired false/true, get_expired_task_ids, cleanup_expired, cleanup_does_not_remove_pending, periodic_cleanup_start_stop

TestScheduledRetention (3 tests): init, start_stop, cleanup_callback_called

TestAgentQueueIntegrator (14 tests): init, set_gateway_executor, submit_agent_task, execute_agent_task, get_task_status, nonexistent task, list_agent_tasks, list_agent_tasks_filtered, get_queue_stats, get_dlq_stats, get_dlq_entries, requeue_dlq_task, requeue_nonexistent

## Test Results
- 566 passed, 7 skipped (up from 542)
  - +24 agent queue integration tests (new)
  - 542 existing tests
- 24 Docker containers running

## Key Achievements
- Addressed GPT-4o Phase 105 High: Task TTL with automatic cleanup ✓
- Addressed GPT-4o Phase 105 Medium: Agent API integration with queue ✓
- Addressed GPT-4o Phase 105 Low: Scheduled retention job ✓
- Agent tasks can now be submitted to queue, tracked, and managed
- DLQ re-queue works end-to-end through the integrator
- TTL only removes terminal tasks (pending/running preserved)
- Scheduled retention automates PG cleanup

## Known Limitations
- DLQ alerting webhook not tested end-to-end
- No WebSocket support for real-time monitoring
- Real execution tests still skipped
- Agent API endpoints not yet exposed through queue_api.py (integration is programmatic only)
- TTL cleanup interval is hardcoded (3600s)
- No per-task TTL override

## Questions for GPT-4o
1. Should we expose agent_queue methods through the queue_api.py REST endpoints?
2. Should we add per-task TTL override (task-level TTL in submit)?
3. What should be the next priority: real execution tests with API keys, OS-level network isolation, WebSocket monitoring, or video providers?
4. Should we integrate the TTL manager and scheduled retention into the queue_api.py startup event?
